text: Roof hole from inside (standing by door) is a tiny blue sliver in a very dark ceiling; crosshair ~35px left of it reads 'Ceiling boards'. Found only after sweeping the ceiling 360 deg and guessing it's above the snow drift. Hint text 'Hole in the roof' only appears when crosshair is nearly on the sliver. Survey completed tick 1982.
Nearest debris 'Fallen shingle 1.5m +2' is not visible; crosshair over the snow drift. E does not pick it up — shingles appear hidden under/inside the snow drift.

Sweep the floor sat at 97-98% for several minutes of in-game sweeping; remaining dirty patches were in the middle of the room (in front of hearth) and by the door, not visibly distinct from clean floor in the dim light. Only found by hovering the crosshair and reading the per-spot '% clean' meter. Floor completed tick 29438, ~8.5 game-minutes of sweeping after the debris.

Scrub the walls: a full 4-row x 120-degree raster of one wall section (~70 s of continuous scrubbing) moved the walls from 13% to 22%. At this rate the walls alone need ~10 more minutes of holding the mouse; ran out of session time before finishing. The per-spot '% clean' meter is helpful but there is no indication of which wall sections are still dirty from a distance.
